abstract: INVENTIONعنوان الابتكار (TITLE OF THE INVENTION) منظومة الطب الذكي والذاتي للأشجار والنباتات بالاعتماد على الذكاء الاصطناعي الذاتي (Autonomous AI-Driven Smart Tree and Plant Medical System) المجال التقني (TECHNICAL FIELD) يتعلق الابتكار الحالي عموماً بتكنولوجيا الزراعة، والروبوتات، والذكاء الاصطناعي، وبشكل أكثر تحديداً بنظام تشخيص وعلاج متعدد الوسائط ومستقل، وإطار تصنيفي لإدارة الرعاية الصحية للنباتات، والأشجار، والبقوليات، والخضروات، وأشجار الفواكه. خلفية وملخص الابتكار (BACKGROUND AND SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION) فتقر الرعاية الزراعية التقليدية إلى تصنيف طبي هيكلي وتدخل إكلينيكي ذاتي في الوقت الفعلي للنباتات والأشجار الفردية. يعالج الابتكار الحالي هذه المشكلة من خلال توفير منظومة طبية ذكية ومستقلة شاملة تدمج واجهات متعددة الوسائط (الصوت، اللمس، الكتابة، والإيماءات)، والكاميرات الذكية، وقواعد بيانات التعلم الذاتي، والروبوتات العلاجية المتخصصة لتشخيص، وتصنيف، ومعالجة أمراض النباتات عبر فروع نباتية متميزة. شرح الرسومات التوضيحية (BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS) الشكل 1 (نظرة عامة على النظام - Autonomous Artificial Intelligence-Driven Smart Tree and Plant Medical System (منظومة الطب الذكي والذاتي للأشجار والنباتات عبر الذكاء الاصطناعي) TECHNICAL FIELD The present invention relates generally to agricultural technology, robotics, and artificial intelligence, and more particularly to an autonomous, multi-modal diagnostic and therapeutic system and classification framework for plant, tree, legume, vegetable, and fruit healthcare management. BACKGROUND AND SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION Traditional agricultural care lacks a structured medical taxonomy and real-time autonomous clinical intervention for individual plants and trees. The present invention solves this problem by providing a comprehensive, autonomous smart medical ecosystem that integrates multi-modal interfaces (voice, touch, writing, and gestures), smart cameras, self-learning AI databases, and specialized robotic applicators to diagnose, categorize, and treat plant pathologies across distinct botanical branches. BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS FIG. 1 (SYSTEM OVERVIEW): Illustrates the overall architecture of the smart medical system, showing the interaction between the Smart AI Core (10), Smart Cameras/Drones (20), Smart Diagnostic Devices (30), Smart Robotic Surgeons (40), and various botanical categories including Seedlings, Fruit Trees, and Legume/Vegetable Plants. FIG. 2 (DIAGNOSTIC METHODS): Depicts the user interface and AI diagnostic routines showing disease classifications such as Bark Canker (32), Leaf Fungus (34), and Internal Trunk Decay (36) processed via autonomous AI data points. FIG. 3 (TREATMENT MODALITIES): Shows the mechanical deployment mechanisms used by the robotic system, including Stem Injectors (44), Canopy Sprayers (48), and Basin Ointment Applicators (50) for liquid delivery, root-zone pouring, or topical cream application. FIG. 4 (TREE ANATOMY CLASSIFICATION): Demonstrates the specialized medical taxonomy of the invention, dividing plant care into internal tree medicine, trunk medicine, bark medicine, seedling medicine, legume medicine, fruit tree medicine, and vegetable medicine. FIG. 5 (OPERATIONAL DATA FLOW): Illustrates the data transmission loop between the AI Core, camera sensors, medical databases, smart devices, and human operator interfaces. DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF PREFERRED EMBODIMENTS System Architecture & Autonomous Core: The system comprises a centralized or distributed Smart AI Core (10) connected via a wireless network to high-definition Smart Cameras (20) and solar-powered charging/control stations. The AI core operates independently using self-learning algorithms to process real-time botanical health data. Multi-Modal User Interaction: Field operators and specialists interact with the system through Smart Diagnostic Devices (30) (such as handheld terminals or mobile tablets) supporting multi-modal inputs including voice commands, handwriting recognition, touch screens, and physical gestures. Specialized Botanical Medical Taxonomy (FIG. 4): The invention introduces a formal classification of plant medicine consisting of: Internal Tree Medicine (علم باطنية الأشجار الذكي): Diagnosing internal vascular and systemic health. Trunk Medicine (علم طب جذوع الأشجار الذكي): Structural and core support evaluation. Bark Medicine (علم طب لحاء الأشجار الذكي): Surface and protective layer healing. Sub-Category Specializations: Dedicated branches covering Seedlings (طب الشتول), Legumes (طب البقوليات), Fruits (طب الفواكه), and Vegetables (طب الخضروات), split further into large mature tree care and early-stage seedling care. Robotic Intervention & Treatment Modalities (FIG. 3): Treatment is executed either by human medical teams or Smart Robotic Surgeons (40) equipped with articulated robotic arms (46). The system delivers treatments via three primary clinical pathways: Basin Pouring / Soil Application (50): Liquid medications poured or dispensed directly into the tree basin. Stem / Trunk Injection (44): Direct micro-injection of therapeutic fluids into the woody core. Topical Ointment Application: Precise mechanical wiping or brushing of therapeutic medical balms onto localized diseased areas on the bark or leaves.

title: 生成式AI在高校图书馆特藏资源开发与创新创业教育融合中的应用研究
abstract: Against the backdrop of the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, university libraries are undergoing a value reconstruction from "knowledge warehouses" to "intelligent engines". This study focuses on the intersection of generative artificial intelligence, the development of special collections in university libraries, and innovation and entrepreneurship education, aiming to explore a new path for activating cultural heritage through technological innovation and empowering the cultivation of innovative talents with cultural resources. The paper first analyzes the intrinsic demands and contemporary opportunities of the development of special collection resources and innovation and entrepreneurship education. Furthermore, it systematically expounds the key technologies and application paradigms of generative AI in the links of text recognition, knowledge reconstruction, interactive presentation and creative derivation of special collection resources; On this basis, an integrated application model of "resource activation - scene construction - ability cultivation" was constructed and supported by cutting-edge practical cases at home and abroad. Finally, a dialectical analysis was conducted on the challenges of data, technology, ethics and talent faced during the integration process, and strategic prospects for the future were proposed. Research shows that generative AI is not only the core driving force for the "digital and intelligent" transformation of special collection resources, but also a key bridge to break down the barriers between cultural inheritance and innovative practice. It provides a practical and feasible solution for university libraries to reshape their educational functions and cultivate compound innovative and entrepreneurial talents in the AI era.
